content:
The image shows a severely desiccated, necrotic plant shoot/twig — completely brown, shriveled, and dead-looking from tip downward. The tissue has collapsed and dried out entirely, with no green remaining. This is classic dieback: progressive death of shoot tips moving downward, resulting in complete browning and desiccation of the affected shoot.

- No white powdery coating → rules out Powdery_Mildew
- No black sooty surface growth → rules out Sooty_Mould
- No discrete dark lesions or acervuli on fruit/leaf → less consistent with Anthracnose
- The entire shoot tip is dead, shriveled, brown — consistent with Die_Back (progressive necrosis from the apex down)
